 14#BY:

Refactor trace code so canonical-v1 and canonical-v2 parsing/semantics are version-owned, output projections are separate from parsing, and production routes/clients/UI cannot cross engines per request.

 19#JR:## Approved decisions
 20#YQ:
 21#TJ:- Architecture: hybrid deep runtime + route-owned native engine bundles.
 22#JK:- Read selection: `GHOSTLINE_TRACE_ENGINE`; unset/empty → `canonical-v2`, exact `canonical-v1` allowed, other values fail boot.
 23#BT:- Selection lifetime: parse once before DB work; immutable until restart; no downstream `process.env` reads.
 24#MW:- Writes: canonical-v2 only under either selected reader; never dual-write.
 25#ZR:- V2 failure: typed canonical non-2xx; never source reconstruction, indexed fallback, v1 query, or cross-engine retry.
 26#RJ:- V1 rollback: faithfully preserve current v1 DB/source/indexed behavior for legacy-available sessions.
 27#QQ:- Routes: boot mounts one native semantic route tree. V1 keeps current semantic routes. V2 mounts canonical-native routes under `/api/v1/sessions/:sessionId/...`; wrong-engine semantic routes return 404.
 28#BQ:- Browser: fetch immutable engine bootstrap once, then construct one engine-specific client/state/render branch; no response-shape probing or fallback client.
 29#SP:- Verification: tests-after each green slice, then dedicated release gate, full parity, lint/boundary checks, and browser QA.
 30#RN:- Persisted data: retain v1 data inert under v2; no semantic backfill or deletion.

 86#BW:## Runtime and ownership contracts
 87#XB:
 88#PY:`createTraceRuntime(...)` returns an immutable process runtime with three responsibilities:
 89#WY:
 90#RK:- `readEngine`: selected `canonical-v1` or `canonical-v2` identity and native semantic route bundle.
 91#TZ:- `ingest`: canonical-v2 writer adapter for the ingestion coordinator.
 92#HN:- `handleHttp`: fixed selected semantic router; it never reads env or accepts engine flags.
 93#BX:
 94#SS:Shared operational routes remain outside engine semantics. Engine-specific parsing, persistence readers, output projection, route parsing, and route error mapping remain inside each engine subtree.

 96#HN:### Route ownership matrix
 97#ZT:
 98#RX:| Route family | V1 process | V2 process | Owner |
 99#TM:| --- | --- | --- | --- |
100#MB:| `/api/health`, `/api/v1/health`, `/api/v1/trace-engine` | mounted | mounted | shared operational router |
101#TQ:| settings, config, ingestion status/run/stream, flags, diagnosis, annotations, source discovery | mounted | mounted | shared operational router; ingestion calls v2 writer |
102#MT:| session/project catalog | legacy-available rows | v2-bound active installations | selected catalog projector |
103#YQ:| current legacy `/api/session/*` semantic routes | mounted | 404 | canonical-v1 route bundle |
104#XW:| current `/api/v1/sessions/:id/{timeline,transcript,findings,entries}` | mounted | 404 unless replaced by an explicitly named v2-native route below | canonical-v1 route bundle |
105#HJ:| `/api/v1/sessions/:id/active-revision` | 404 | mounted | canonical-v2 route bundle |
106#BN:| trace record/turn page and around routes | 404 | mounted | canonical-v2 route bundle |
107#QY:| canonical transcript item/around/diagnostic routes | 404 | mounted | canonical-v2 route bundle |
108#VQ:| canonical evidence and field-expansion routes | 404 | mounted | canonical-v2 route bundle |
109#ZN:| v2 timeline/stats/findings/graph/session-map continuity routes | 404 | mounted | canonical-v2 analytics outputs |
110#WY:
111#PP:Complex frozen request DTOs use POST bodies; active-revision/bootstrap metadata uses GET. Route code validates with owning Zod schemas and maps canonical errors exactly.

122#HK:Existing `Session.id` and `normalizedPath` remain stable catalog/source keys. Existing flags/project/source metadata remain reusable. V2 catalog queries include only rows whose canonical-v2 binding resolves to an active `CanonicalV2Installation`. V1 queries include only `legacyTraceAvailable=true` rows.

124#JN:V2 ingestion updates the catalog binding inside the same transaction as revision persistence and activation. The `CanonicalV2Installation` upsert remains the final visibility statement.
